When it is done she grunts. "Plainly asked. That's more than I get from most."
She glances at Tie Bo. "Your brother's boar. I thought it might come to that."

event: She lifts the latch and swings the gate open, and steps back into her yard, into the full sun.
The garden is rows of green: feathery leaves, grey-green leaves, tall stalks, some flowering blue.
